ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: druid
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Druids are the voice of every living thing on the rim. They call beasts, raise thorns, heal with sap and make barren land bloom.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Speak for the wild. Roots and thorns, beasts and shapes, harvests and healing.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: The land remembers who was kind to it.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: A flexible all-rounder with the best farming utility in the game. Entangle and Thorn Volley in combat, Bloom and Fertile Ground at home. Wants Focus and Resilience.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: beastmaster
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Beastmasters gather a menagerie: summoned bears, wargs and, at the peak of their power, a thrumbo. They can tame any animal with a word.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Bears, wargs and thrumbos fight at your side. Tame anything that walks.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: She whistled. The ground shook. Then the thrumbo arrived.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Summoner with tons of bodies. Feral Command empowers every animal ally. Tame Beast brings home anything. Wants Focus and Attunement.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: verdant warden
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Verdant Wardens shape living fortresses. Their groves heal, their thorn walls bleed attackers, and their spores choke enemies.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Groves that heal, walls of thorns and the ancient World Tree.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: The ancient tree at the heart of Greywood has stood for eight hundred years. Raiders have stopped trying to cut it down.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Defensive area control and healing. Plant a Healing Grove, wall off approaches with thorns, and raise the World Tree in desperate fights. Wants Focus and Resilience.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: shapeshifter
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Shapeshifters wear the wild like a cloak. In bear form they are walls; in wolf form they are blurs; as a thrumbo, they are gods.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Become the beast. Bear, wolf and the mighty thrumbo.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: 'Is that... a bear?' 'That's Teodor.' 'Why is Teodor a bear?' 'Raid day.'
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: A melee bruiser. Shift into Bear Form to tank or Wolf Form to chase, Maul and Roar your way through enemies, and unleash Thrumbo Avatar for boss fights. Wants Resilience and Celerity.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: pack leader
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Call of the Wild summons another wolf per rank.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: thornmail
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Thorns grow beneath your skin. Melee attackers bleed for it.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: harvest moon
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: You are the finest farmer alive.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: photosynthesis
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: You draw strength from the world. Slowly regenerate health and mana at all times.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: overgrowth
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: The wild turns violent. Nature spells hit harder and often entangle.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: lifewell
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Everything you cast spills life into those around you.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: archdruid
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: The wild answers you unbidden: in combat, wolves arrive every thirty seconds.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: grizzly
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Summon Bear calls an extra bear per rank.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: howl
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Kills may summon a free pair of wolves.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: primal pack
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your allies always fight with feral ferocity near you.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: king of beasts
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every beast-summoning spell calls one more creature, and they all stay far longer.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: grove sentinel
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Allies near you are always covered in barkskin.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: living bastion
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Become an ancient tree: massive ward and armor, and everything that hurts you is torn by thorns.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: the gardener
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your groves come quickly and heal mightily.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: apex predator
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Melee hits feed you mana, and you shrug off melee blows.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: spirit of ursoc
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: The great bear spirit protects you: when downed, you rise again in a roar. Once per day.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: spirit of fenris
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: The wolf spirit hunts through you: weapon hits may Maul for free and every spell finishes the weak.

AbilityDef.label: thorn volley
AbilityDef.description: Fling a spray of hardened thorns at nearby enemies.

AbilityDef.label: entangle
AbilityDef.description: Roots burst from the ground and bind every enemy in an area.

AbilityDef.label: rejuvenation
AbilityDef.description: Fill an ally with green life: an immediate heal and lasting regeneration.

AbilityDef.label: barkskin
AbilityDef.description: Harden an ally's skin into living bark.

AbilityDef.label: bloom
AbilityDef.description: Life surges through the soil. Plants grow at a staggering pace and wild flowers sprout from the earth.

AbilityDef.label: call of the wild
AbilityDef.description: Howl, and a pair of timber wolves answer, fighting for you for a minute.

AbilityDef.label: fertile ground
AbilityDef.description: Enrich the earth itself. Plain soil in the area becomes rich soil, permanently.

AbilityDef.label: wrath of nature
AbilityDef.description: A wave of thorns and roots tears through the ground toward the target.

AbilityDef.label: earthquake
AbilityDef.description: Stamp, and the earth answers. The ground heaves around you, knocking enemies flat and battering them with stone.

AbilityDef.label: nature's renewal
AbilityDef.description: Pour the patient strength of the forest into an ally: heals, cures an age-related or chronic condition and fades two scars with each casting.

AbilityDef.label: summon bear
AbilityDef.description: A grizzly bear lumbers out of the wilderness to fight for you for two minutes.

AbilityDef.label: feral command
AbilityDef.description: Every ally around you - especially beasts - fights with primal ferocity.

AbilityDef.label: tame beast
AbilityDef.description: Speak to an animal in its own tongue. It joins the colony.

AbilityDef.label: stampede
AbilityDef.description: A spectral herd thunders toward the target, trampling and scattering everything in its path.

AbilityDef.label: thrumbo call
AbilityDef.description: The great white thrumbo answers your call, flanked by two wargs, for three minutes.

AbilityDef.label: alpha's call
AbilityDef.description: Let out the call of the pack leader. Every animal in a wide area that isn't too wild comes to your side for good.

AbilityDef.label: thorn wall
AbilityDef.description: Grow a thicket of thorny walls around a point. Enemies near the walls are slashed.

AbilityDef.label: healing grove
AbilityDef.description: Plant a blessed sapling that heals every ally near it for a minute.

AbilityDef.label: spore cloud
AbilityDef.description: Release a cloud of choking spores that poison and disorient.

AbilityDef.label: nature's grasp
AbilityDef.description: The whole area erupts with grasping roots and thorns.

AbilityDef.label: the world tree
AbilityDef.description: Raise an echo of the World Tree. For two minutes it heals every ally in a huge radius, while roots bind every enemy near you.

AbilityDef.label: verdant surge
AbilityDef.description: A wave of green life rolls over your allies, healing them, purging poisons and fading a scar from each.

AbilityDef.label: bear form
AbilityDef.description: Become a great bear for a minute: thick hide, crushing blows.

AbilityDef.label: wolf form
AbilityDef.description: Become a swift wolf for a minute.

AbilityDef.label: maul
AbilityDef.description: Savage an adjacent enemy with a brutal swipe that stuns.

AbilityDef.label: primal roar
AbilityDef.description: A roar that shakes the bones. Nearby enemies panic and flee, weakened.

AbilityDef.label: thrumbo avatar
AbilityDef.description: Take the form of the thrumbo, the god-beast of the rim: nearly invulnerable, regenerating, devastating.

AbilityDef.label: pounce
AbilityDef.description: Leap like a great cat onto a distant enemy, mauling them and knocking them off their feet.

ThingDef.label: thorn wall
ThingDef.description: A thicket of conjured thorns. Enemies pressed against it are slashed.

ThingDef.label: healing grove
ThingDef.description: A blessed sapling radiating life. It heals allies near it.

ThingDef.label: world tree echo
ThingDef.description: An echo of the World Tree. Its roots knit flesh for a great distance.
